message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most important prophet—and indeed the central figure of the faith. While prophets such as Moses, Isaiah, and Jeremiah are highly respected and foundational, Jesus is seen as the fulfillment of the prophetic tradition, the one who brings the final revelation of God’s will and the promise of salvation. His life, teachings, death, and resurrection are considered the cornerstone of Christian belief.
